rationale: Swift second review wave: SW-G super/self init delegation constructs (dart DT-D parity; never calls to init), SW-H implicit (.a(v)) and Self (Self.a(v)) enum-case construction resolves against the enclosing enum. Every pin probe-verified against both the analyzer and deriveSwiftEdges before pinning; lanes confirm the pair agrees on corpora.

expectRelationships.note: M59.A7: the base SPECIFIER's own line in the inheritance clause, not the class declaration's

expectRelationships.comment: SW-G: super.init builds the superclass — line 9 is `super.init(x)`
SW-G: self.init builds the own class — line 12 is `self.init(0)`
SW-H: implicit .success(v) builds the enclosing enum; the site IS line 20
SW-H: Self.failure builds the enclosing enum; the site IS line 23

forbidRelationships.comment: SW-G: init delegation never calls a method named init

M59.A7 line pin: the delegation's site is the CALL (line 9, `super.init(x)`), never the enclosing declaration's line (8, `override init(_ x: Int) {`) — an edge that borrows the declaration's line is not checkable against the source
M59.A7 line pin: the construction's site is the EXPRESSION (20), never its enclosing `static func make` declaration (19)
